# DIFC Office & Link Bridge

> CP-05 is an office building at the Dubai International Financial Centre, arranged as ten office floors above a concourse level and three podium parking decks, with three further basement levels below. The floorplates are laid out for flexible tenancies and co-working suites aimed at smaller and start-up firms. The building holds two restaurants, one at concourse level and a fine-dining venue at the top, and a podium link bridge ties it into Gate Avenue, the district's retail spine.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: DIFC, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

DIFC CP-05 is an office building on Plot CP-05 in the Dubai International Financial Centre, designed around flexible office floors and co-working space for start-ups, with a concourse-level restaurant, a top-floor fine-dining venue and three basement levels of parking. A podium link bridge connects the building to the Gate Avenue retail spine. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the office building and link bridge.
